d1.purpose: לוח שעות לכיתה י׳2 בסמסטר א׳, המאפשר למצוא שיעורים ולקרוא הוראות הנוגעות להם.
tasks: לאתר יום ושעה ולזהות את המקצוע, המורה והחדר.
לעקוב ברצף אחר השיעורים בכל יום ולהשוות בין שעות או חדרים.
לקרוא את ההערות כהכנה לשיעור ולהבין לאיזה שיעור כל הערה שייכת.
relations: כל שורה מקשרת שעת שיעור אחת למקצוע, למורה, לחדר ולהערה שלה.
תאי היום הממוזגים מקבצים שיעורים עוקבים לאותו יום.
ההערות משלימות את פרטי השיעור ולעיתים כוללות הוראות שהן חיוניות להכנה.
roles: הכותרות מזהות את ששת סוגי המידע; עמודת היום הימנית משמשת ככותרת לקבוצת שורות.
שעה ומקצוע הם מפתחות מרכזיים לאיתור שיעור; מורה וחדר מסייעים לזיהוי ולהגעה.
עמודת ההערות השמאלית מכילה טקסט רציף וארוך בהרבה משאר העמודות.
keep_whole: טווחי השעות, כדי לאפשר סריקה והשוואה מהירות.
מספרי חדרים ומילים בודדות; רצוי לשמור גם שמות מורים ושמות חדרים בשלמותם ככל שהרוחב מאפשר.
may_wrap: הערות יכולות להישבר בין מילים ולתפוס כמה שורות.
שמות מורים וחדרים בני כמה מילים יכולים להישבר בין מילים כאשר הדבר מפנה מקום משמעותי להערות.
same_scale: עמודות המקצוע, המורה והחדר מכילות פרטי זיהוי קצרים וצריכות להישאר בקנה מידה דומה בקירוב.
עמודת היום יכולה להיות צרה יותר; עמודת השעה זקוקה לרוחב מספק לטווח שלם, ועמודת ההערות צריכה להיות רחבה בהרבה.
d1.h_vs_v: רוחב המסך מוגבל, ולכן ההערות הארוכות יגדילו את גובה השורות בכל חלופה. הרחבת ההערות מצמצמת גלישה אנכית, אך עלולה לפצל שמות מורים וחדרים; שמירת כל פרטי הזיהוי בשורה אחת מגדילה את גובה ההערות.

tasks: לקרוא הוראות ושינויים הנוגעים לשיעור מסוים
relations: כל שורה מקשרת בין זמן, מקצוע, מורה, חדר והערה
שם יום ממוזג חל על כל שורות השיעורים שהוא מקיף
הערות עשויות להכיל כמה הוראות או פרטי הקשר לאותו שיעור

d2.h_vs_v: רוחב נוסף להערות מצמצם את גובה השורות ומקל על קריאתן; שמירת שאר השדות בשורה אחת משפרת סריקה והשוואה. טבלה צרה יותר חוסכת רוחב אך מאריכה את ההערות ואת הטבלה.

d3.purpose: A weekly class timetable for semester A, organized by day and lesson.
tasks: Find a lesson by day and time.
Identify its subject, teacher and room.
Read any instructions or changes in the notes.
relations: Each lesson row connects a time, subject, teacher, room and note.
Merged day labels group consecutive lessons on the same day.
Notes qualify individual lessons and can contain several instructions.
roles: The day column provides grouped row labels; the time column identifies each lesson within a day.
Subject, teacher and room are compact lookup fields.
The notes column carries variable-length prose.
Column headers identify each field and should remain easy to scan.
keep_whole: Day names, subject names and column headers.
Each time range, including both endpoints and the dash.
Individual words, room numbers and identifiers.
may_wrap: Notes may wrap at natural word boundaries.
Teacher names and multiword room names may wrap between words if needed.
same_scale: Day, subject, teacher and room are short lookup fields, though their widths should reflect their content.
Time ranges need a consistent, uninterrupted measure; notes need substantially more space than the lookup fields.
d3.h_vs_v: Using the full viewport gives the long notes more room and reduces row height. A narrower table can make the lookup fields more compact, but increases wrapping and makes the timetable taller; merged day labels remain associated with all rows in their groups.

analysis.strengths: All headers and words remain intact, the time ranges and teacher names stay on one line, and the laboratory number stays with its room name. The merged day labels make the timetable easy to scan.
analysis.faults: The sports hall name wraps onto two lines. Two notes take three lines, making their rows taller and interrupting the otherwise regular row rhythm.
analysis.spatial_logic: Gives the notes most of the available width while keeping the day, time, subject and teacher columns just wide enough for their one-line content. The room column is a compromise: it fits the laboratory label but not the sports hall label.

analysis.strengths: Like P, it preserves intact words, single-line headers and time ranges, and keeps the laboratory label together. The room column has slightly more breathing room.
analysis.faults: The extra two pixels in the room column do not prevent the sports hall name from wrapping. The narrower notes column changes some line breaks without reducing either tall row.
analysis.spatial_logic: Moves two pixels from notes to room relative to P. That allocation produces no clear functional gain in the rendered table.

analysis.strengths: The wider notes column reduces the physics note from three lines to two, making that row shorter and giving six of the seven lesson rows a consistent height. Headers, time ranges and individual words remain intact.
analysis.faults: The laboratory name and its number split across lines, weakening a room identifier that readers need to find quickly. The sports hall name also wraps, and the last note still needs three lines.
analysis.spatial_logic: Transfers space from the room column to notes. This improves the note wrapping and overall height, but does so at the expense of keeping a room label together.

rounds.insights: The decisive trade-off is between continuous notes and quickly recognizable room labels. R demonstrates that a small increase in note width can remove a line, but its height advantage comes with a split laboratory identifier. P preserves that identifier and is the stronger balance among the rendered options; Q spends additional room width without an apparent benefit. A wider room column could keep both named rooms on one line, though its effect on note wrapping must be checked in a render.

contrast.why: The time column has only 79 px of text space, less than the 89 px needed for a complete time range. The narrow notes column also creates unnecessary wrapping, while the day column receives more width than its content needs.

sameFunctionGroups.why: Subject, teacher and room are compact lesson descriptors, but their content lengths differ. Each should receive enough space for useful units rather than an equal width.

synthesis.rationale: P keeps the time ranges and the room label מעבדה 1 together while giving the notes enough width for readable lines. Q is almost identical in effect, so it does not offer a meaningfully different finalist. R gains a shorter row by giving more space to notes, but separates מעבדה from its room number, making that location less immediate to scan.

general: Preserve complete lookup units such as time ranges and room identifiers where space permits.
Allocate width according to content and reading task, and judge the resulting line breaks in the rendered table.
specific: The long notes need most of the available width, but the room column benefits from enough space to keep מעבדה 1 together.
P and Q are too similar in width and rendered behavior to warrant separate finalist submissions.

synthesis.tradeoffs: R saves 23 px in table height and improves one notes break, at the cost of splitting a room label. P and Q retain that label on one line but leave the physics note at three lines.
synthesis.uncertain: The relative importance of compact height and keeping the room label together depends on how the timetable will be used; R remains publishable if the shorter table is preferred.

critique.good: כל טווחי השעות, שמות המקצועות, המורים והחדרים נשארים שלמים. קבוצות הימים ברורות, וכל הטבלה נכנסת לרוחב הנתון.
critique.problems: כמה הערות נפרשות על שלוש שורות, וכך נוצרות שורות גבוהות ורווחים ריקים גדולים לצד פרטי השיעור הקצרים.
critique.cause: רוחב ההערות, 277 פיקסלים, מוגבל משום שעמודות המורה והחדר רחבות מספיק לכל התוכן שלהן בשורה אחת.

critique.good: עמודת ההערות הרחבה משפרת את רצף הקריאה ומביאה לרוב שורות השיעורים גובה אחיד. היום, השעה והמקצוע נוחים לסריקה, והטבלה היא הנמוכה מבין השלוש.
critique.problems: שמות מורים רבים ושני שמות חדרים מתפצלים לשורות; במיוחד הפיצול של מעבדה 1 מרחיק את המספר משם החדר ומקשה מעט על הזיהוי.
critique.cause: עמודת המורה ברוחב 72 פיקסלים ועמודת החדר ברוחב 67 פיקסלים צרות משמות מלאים בני כמה מילים.

critique.good: פרטי הזיהוי נשארים בשורה אחת, והימים והשעות ברורים וקלים לאיתור.
critique.problems: ההערות נקטעות לשורות קצרות רבות, ובהערה האחרונה לארבע שורות. הגובה הגדול והרווחים הריקים בעמודות הזיהוי מקשים על סקירה רציפה של המערכת.
critique.cause: רוחב של 237 פיקסלים להערות, לצד רוחב עודף למקצוע, למורה ולחדר, משאיר מעט מקום לטקסט הארוך.

critique.good: Days, time ranges, subjects and teacher names remain whole. The notes are readable, and the merged day cells clearly group lessons.
critique.problems: The sports hall name wraps, and two notes occupy three lines, creating taller rows and more white space beside short lesson details.
critique.cause: The 82 px room column is too narrow for the full hall name; the 292 px notes column produces three-line notes in the physics and physical education rows.

critique.good: Room names remain on one line, and day, time and subject columns support quick scanning.
critique.problems: Several teacher names split across lines, while three notes occupy three lines. The first lesson is noticeably taller than in the other designs.
critique.cause: The 78 px teacher column is too narrow for several full names, and the 288 px notes column makes the first note wrap to three lines. The 97 px room column uses width that could help elsewhere.

critique.good: The wider notes column keeps all but the final note to two lines, giving the table a compact, even rhythm. Times and subjects remain whole.
critique.problems: Several teacher names and both named rooms split across lines. The separated lab number is particularly awkward for locating the room.
critique.cause: The 72 px teacher and 67 px room columns sacrifice identification details to give the notes 324 px.

critique.good: Fits the viewport. Day names, time ranges, subjects and teacher names remain whole. Notes mostly occupy two lines, giving the rows a consistent rhythm.
critique.problems: Both named rooms wrap; in particular, the laboratory number sits on a separate line from its name. The final note takes three lines.
critique.cause: The 67 px room column has only 46 px of text space. The 307 px notes column leaves the final note on three lines.

critique.good: Fits the viewport and keeps the laboratory name and number together. Time ranges and subjects remain easy to scan.
critique.problems: One teacher name and the sports hall name wrap. The physics note gains a third line, making that row taller and disrupting the otherwise regular rhythm.
critique.cause: The 84 px teacher and 82 px room columns are slightly too narrow for their longest full names. Giving the room more space leaves 297 px for notes.

critique.good: Fits the viewport and keeps teacher names, time ranges and the laboratory name together. The short identification columns remain clear and well grouped.
critique.problems: The sports hall name wraps, and the physics and final notes each take three lines. The narrower notes column produces a taller, denser table.
critique.cause: The room column is 82 px, below the 97 px needed for its widest one-line content; the notes column is 292 px.

critique.good: Fits the viewport and gives the notes the most space. The table has a compact height, and time ranges and subjects remain whole.
critique.problems: Several teacher names wrap, weakening quick identification and creating a choppy vertical rhythm. Both named rooms also wrap, including the separated laboratory number.
critique.cause: The 72 px teacher and 67 px room columns trade away full names for a 324 px notes column; the extra notes width does not reduce the overall height compared with d1r2A.

critique.good: כל הטקסט נראה, הכותרות וטווחי השעות שלמים, והימים הממוזגים מקבצים את השיעורים בבירור. ההערות נקראות ברצף ללא שבירת מילים.
critique.problems: שני שמות חדרים נשברים לשתי שורות, ושורת הפיזיקה גבוהה בגלל הערה בת שלוש שורות. השורה הגבוהה יוצרת מרווח רב בעמודות הזיהוי.
critique.cause: רוחב החדר, 76 פיקסלים, אינו מספיק לשמות החדרים המלאים; רוחב ההערות, 298 פיקסלים, גורם להערת הפיזיקה להישבר לשלוש שורות.

critique.good: כל הטקסט נראה והטבלה שומרת על סריקה ברורה של היום, השעה והמקצוע. ההערה בשורת הפיזיקה נכנסת לשתי שורות, ולכן הטבלה נמוכה יותר.
critique.problems: שמות שני החדרים הארוכים נשברים לשתי שורות, והערת השיעור האחרון עדיין תופסת שלוש שורות. הפיצול בין שם החדר למספרו בשורת הפיזיקה מאט מעט את הקריאה.
critique.cause: רוחב החדר, 67 פיקסלים, מספיק למילה הארוכה ביותר אך לא לשמות המלאים. רוחב ההערות, 307 פיקסלים, משפר את שבירת הערת הפיזיקה אך אינו מספיק לשתי שורות בהערה האחרונה.

critique.good: The day groups, complete time ranges and subjects are easy to scan. Room names stay together, and the notes are legible without broken words.
critique.problems: Several teacher names split across lines, making the identification columns less consistent. Two notes occupy three lines, leaving the table taller and less even in rhythm.

critique.good: All teacher names and time ranges stay together. The wider notes column reduces one row from three lines to two, giving the table a more even rhythm.

critique.cause: The 67px room column leaves only 46px for text, too little for the complete room labels.

critique.good: Fits the viewport and keeps days, time ranges, subjects, teachers and rooms on single lines. The merged day cells clearly group lessons, and the notes remain readable without breaking words.
critique.problems: Several notes occupy three lines, making their rows taller and leaving substantial empty space in the identification columns.
critique.cause: The 277px notes column is constrained by the 89px teacher and 97px room columns, which preserve single-line labels but leave less room for continuous prose.

critique.good: The 328px notes column gives most notes two lines and produces a compact table. Days, time ranges and subjects remain easy to scan, and no words are broken.
critique.problems: Every teacher name wraps, as do the two named rooms. This fragments lesson identification and makes the narrow columns feel crowded, even though the table is shorter.
critique.cause: The 68px teacher and 67px room columns leave too little text width for full names and room labels.

critique.good: The identification fields remain on one line, and the table fits comfortably within the viewport. Day groups and time ranges are clear.
critique.problems: Notes form narrow blocks of three or four lines, making the table substantially taller and increasing the distance between lessons. The unused viewport space does not help the reading task.
critique.cause: The 207px notes column is 70px narrower than in d2r0A while the other columns retain the same widths.

critique.good: כל התוכן גלוי, טווחי השעות ושמות המורים נשארים בשורה אחת, וקבוצות הימים ברורות. ההערות קריאות והטבלה נכנסת בדיוק לרוחב הזמין.
critique.problems: שם החדר אולם ספורט נשבר לשתי שורות, בניגוד לרוב שדות הזיהוי האחרים. שתי הערות ארוכות תופסות שלוש שורות.
critique.cause: רוחב החדר הוא 78 פיקסלים, פחות מ־97 הפיקסלים הנדרשים לתוכן הרחב ביותר בשורה אחת. הרחבתו תבוא על חשבון ההערות או שדות אחרים.

critique.good: התוכן גלוי, השעות נשארות שלמות, וההערות שומרות על אותו מספר שורות וגובה טבלה כמו ב־d2r1A.
critique.problems: כמה שמות מורים נשברים לשתי שורות, וגם אולם ספורט נשבר. הדבר מקשה על סריקה מהירה של פרטי השיעור.
critique.cause: רוחב המורה הוא 80 פיקסלים, פחות מ־89 הפיקסלים הנדרשים לשם הרחב ביותר בשורה אחת; רוחב החדר הוא 88 פיקסלים, ועדיין אינו מספיק לשם החדר הארוך.

critique.good: כל שמות המורים והחדרים וטווחי השעות נשארים בשורה אחת, וקבוצות הימים ברורות.
critique.problems: שתי ההערות הראשונות נשברות לשלוש שורות ומסתיימות בשורות קצרות, והטבלה גבוהה יותר ב־47 פיקסלים. התוספת לרוחב החדר מועילה רק למספר קטן של תאים.
critique.cause: רוחב החדר הוא 97 פיקסלים, אך ההערות מצטמצמות ל־277 פיקסלים; הצמצום מעביר שתי הערות נוספות לשלוש שורות.

critique.good: Fits the viewport; day names, time ranges, subjects and teachers remain on one line. Notes wrap at word boundaries, with a reasonably compact overall height.
critique.problems: Both the laboratory identifier and the sports hall name wrap, making room lookup less immediate. The laboratory number sits alone on a second line.
critique.cause: The 72px room column is too narrow for those complete labels; the 302px notes column uses the space saved.

critique.good: The laboratory identifier fits on one line, and the identifying columns remain easy to scan. Notes wrap without breaking words.
critique.problems: The sports hall name still wraps despite the wider room column. The first note gains a third line, making the table taller and creating more unused vertical space in its neighboring cells.
critique.cause: The 94px room column is still below the 97px needed for the widest one-line room label; reducing notes to 280px triggers an extra line in the first row.

critique.good: The laboratory identifier fits on one line while the notes retain the same row heights as d2r2A. Time ranges, subjects and teachers remain intact, and the table fits the viewport.
critique.problems: The sports hall name wraps, and the longer notes create some uneven row heights and short final lines.
critique.cause: The 78px room column accommodates the laboratory label but not the sports hall name; the 296px notes column must carry the remaining long text.

critique.good: All headers, time ranges, teacher names and room labels remain on one line. The day groups are clear, and the notes wrap at word boundaries.
critique.problems: Several notes take three lines, making the lesson rows tall and leaving large areas of empty space in the lookup columns.
critique.cause: The 277px notes column is constrained by allocating 89px to teachers and 97px to rooms, enough to keep their full contents on one line.

critique.good: The wider notes column produces a compact, regular table: six lesson rows are two lines high, and the notes remain readable. Headers and time ranges stay whole.
critique.problems: Several teacher names wrap, and the room labels split across lines; in particular, the number in מעבדה 1 sits apart from its word. This weakens quick scanning of those fields.
critique.cause: The 75px teacher and 77px room columns trade lookup-field continuity for a 311px notes column.

critique.good: The lookup fields remain on one line, and the merged day labels still group their lessons clearly.
critique.problems: Notes form narrow, fragmented blocks of up to five lines, making the table much taller and leaving substantial empty space in the other columns. Unused viewport width sits to the left.
critique.cause: The notes column is only 200px wide, while the table uses just 643px of the available 720px.

critique.good: All headers, time ranges, subjects and teacher names remain on one line. The notes are generally readable, and the merged day labels clearly group lessons.
critique.problems: The two multiword room names wrap, including a room number isolated on its own line. Two notes occupy three lines.
critique.cause: The 77px room column is too narrow for the full room names; the 297px notes column determines the taller rows.

critique.good: The compact lookup fields, including both multiword room names, remain on one line. The day groups and lesson associations are clear.
critique.problems: The first two notes need three lines, producing a noticeably taller and less even table. The room column uses space that would help the much longer notes.
critique.cause: The 97px room column preserves full room names, leaving 277px for notes.

critique.good: The widest notes column gives the prose a comfortable measure and keeps all but the final lesson row to two lines. Headers, times and subjects remain whole.
critique.problems: Several teacher names and both multiword room names wrap. The fragmented names make the lookup fields less easy to scan, even though the table is shorter.
critique.cause: The 75px teacher and 77px room columns give 311px to notes, trading compact lookup entries for fewer note lines.

critique.good: The table fits the viewport, keeps headers and time ranges on one line, and gives notes enough width for all but the last lesson to occupy two lines. Day groups and lesson rows remain easy to follow.
critique.problems: The lab name and its number are separated across lines, and the sports hall name also wraps. These breaks slow room lookup, especially where the isolated lab number could be missed.
critique.cause: The 67 px room column is too narrow for either multiword room name.

critique.good: The timetable fits the viewport, with intact headers, time ranges and words. The room column has more breathing space than in d3r2A.
critique.problems: The wider room column still breaks both multiword room names, while the lab lesson’s note gains a third line. This makes that row taller without resolving the room lookup issue.
critique.cause: At 77 px, the room column remains narrower than the 97 px needed for its widest content; taking 10 px from notes reduces their width to 297 px.

critique.good: All content fits the viewport; day and subject labels, time ranges, and room names remain whole. Notes wrap at word boundaries, and merged day labels clearly group lessons.
critique.problems: Every teacher name breaks across two lines, making that lookup column unnecessarily fragmented. Two notes occupy three lines, including a short final line in the physics note.
critique.cause: The 69px teacher column is too narrow for full names. The 297px notes column causes some longer notes to wrap to three lines.

critique.good: Teacher names and time ranges remain on one line. The wider notes column reduces the physics note to two lines, making the table shorter while retaining clear day groupings.
critique.problems: The room names מעבדה 1 and אולם ספורט break across lines, separating the room number from its label and making room lookup less continuous. The final note still takes three lines.
critique.cause: The 67px room column is too narrow for multiword room names. The 307px notes column is still too narrow to keep the longest note to two lines.

critique.good: All headers, day names, times, subjects and teacher names remain on one line. The room label מעבדה 1 stays together, and notes wrap without breaking words. The table fits the viewport.
critique.problems: The physics note takes three lines, increasing that row’s height. אולם ספורט wraps across two lines, although the other room entries are compact.
critique.cause: The 294px notes column forces an extra line in the physics note; the 80px room column is too narrow for אולם ספורט on one line.

critique.good: The 307px notes column keeps the physics note to two lines, making the table shorter. Headers, times, subjects and teacher names remain on one line, and the table fits the viewport.
critique.problems: מעבדה 1 separates the room type from its number, and אולם ספורט also wraps. The isolated number is especially awkward for a room lookup.
critique.cause: The 67px room column leaves only 46px for text; the additional 13px given to notes improves the physics row at the expense of room labels.

d3r0A.idea: Keep the lookup fields on one line and give the remaining width to notes, using the full viewport.

d3r0B.idea: Allow teacher and room names to wrap between words, reserving more width for the lengthy notes.

d3r0C.idea: Use a narrower table with single-line lookup fields and a compact prose column, accepting taller lesson rows.

d2r0A.idea: ניצול רוחב התצוגה תוך שמירת שדות היום, השעה, המקצוע, המורה והחדר בשורה אחת והקצאת היתרה להערות.

d2r0B.idea: מתן עדיפות לקריאה רציפה של ההערות, במחיר שבירה אפשרית של שמות מורים וחדרים בין מילים.

d2r0C.idea: טבלה צרה יותר המשאירה מרחב פנוי בתצוגה ושומרת את שדות הזיהוי בשורה אחת, במחיר הערות גבוהות יותר.

d1r0A.idea: שומרת את כל פרטי הזיהוי בשורה אחת ומקדישה את יתרת הרוחב להערות.

d1r0B.idea: מעניקה עדיפות לקריאת ההערות ולצמצום גובהן, תוך מתן אפשרות לשמות מורים וחדרים להישבר בין מילים.

d1r0C.idea: מעניקה מרווח נדיב ושקול לפרטי הזיהוי לסריקה נוחה, במחיר של הערות צרות וגבוהות יותר.

d3r1A.idea: Keep teacher names on one line as in A, while moving 20px from the room column to notes. This tests a middle ground: more continuous notes and shorter rows, accepting wrapped multiword room labels.

d2r1A.idea: Keep teacher names on one line and give notes 19px more than d2r0A. The narrower room column may wrap the longest room labels; test whether the improved notes justify that tradeoff.

d2r1B.idea: Share the reduction between teacher and room columns to give notes 18px more than d2r0A. Test whether most names and room labels remain intact while notes become less tall.

d1r1A.idea: להחזיר את שמות המורים לשורה אחת ולתת לחדר יותר מקום מאשר ב־B, תוך שמירה על עמודת הערות רחבה יותר מזו של A. יש לבדוק ברינדור אם השיפור בזיהוי מצדיק את תוספת גובה ההערות, ואילו שמות חדרים עדיין מתפצלים.

d1r1B.idea: לבדוק חלופה המעדיפה שמות חדרים שלמים על פני שמות מורים שלמים: הדבר עשוי להקל על מציאת מקום השיעור, תוך מתן מקום רב יותר להערות מאשר ב־A.

d3r2A.idea: Keep teacher names on one line and use the minimum measured width for room words, allowing multiword room names to wrap. Give the recovered 10px to notes to test whether the physics note becomes shorter while preserving the strongest lookup features of d3r1A.

d2r2A.idea: לצמצם את החדר בשישה פיקסלים ולהרחיב את ההערות בהתאם. יש לבדוק אם הרוחב הנוסף משפר את שבירת ההערות, תוך שמירה על שמות המורים והשעות בשורה אחת וללא שבירה בתוך יחידת חדר.

d2r2B.idea: לבדוק נקודת ביניים המעניקה לחדר כמעט את מלוא הרוחב הדרוש לשורה אחת ומותירה להערות מעט יותר מקום מאשר ב־d2r0A. ייתכן שהשם הארוך עדיין יישבר; הרינדור יראה אם מתקבל איזון טוב יותר.

d1r2A.idea: Keep teacher names whole as in d1r1A and move 15 px from the room column to the notes. Test whether the physics note becomes two lines; named rooms will wrap.

d1r2B.idea: Move 5 px from teacher to notes while retaining d1r1A's room width. Test whether the added notes width improves wrapping without splitting too many teacher names.

d3r3A.idea: Give the room column enough width to keep both room names whole. Recover most of that space from the teacher column, allowing names to wrap between words, and use the remaining width for notes. This tests whether clearer room lookup is worth the resulting teacher and note wrapping.

d2r3A.idea: Give the room column the measured 97px needed for its widest label, keeping all room names on one line. Test whether the resulting narrower notes column produces an acceptable height and reading rhythm.

d1r3A.idea: Keep all teacher and room names on one line, including the sports hall. Test whether the narrower notes column produces an acceptable increase in row height.

d1r3B.idea: This allocation has already been rendered as d1r1A and should not be tested again.

d1r3C.idea: Test an intermediate room width that may keep the laboratory name and number together while preserving more space for notes; compare the resulting wraps with d1r2A.

d3r4A.idea: Give both teacher and room columns enough width for their full one-line contents. Test whether the resulting narrower notes column preserves a useful balance between compact lookup fields and prose wrapping.

d3r4B.idea: Try a compromise that gives room names more space while preserving more width for notes. Check whether the room breaks improve and whether the notes retain the shorter rhythm of d3r2A.

d3r5A.idea: Restore enough room width to keep מעבדה 1 together while retaining the wider notes column. The narrower teacher column may wrap some names, so check whether that trade improves lookup and row heights.

d3r5B.idea: Give the room column enough width for all room labels on one line while preserving complete teacher names. Check whether the narrower notes column adds enough wrapping to outweigh the cleaner lookup fields.

d1r4A.idea: להרחיב את עמודת החדר כך ששמות החדרים המלאים יישארו בשורה אחת, ולבדוק אם תוספת השורות בהערות היא מחיר סביר לשיפור באיתור החדר.

d1r4B.idea: לשמור את שמות החדרים בשורה אחת ולהחזיר חלק מהרוחב להערות באמצעות צמצום עמודת המורה. כך אפשר לבדוק אם פיצול חלק משמות המורים מניב איזון טוב יותר.

d1r5A.idea: Keep complete teacher and room names by giving both columns their measured one-line widths. Test whether the narrower notes column remains readable enough to justify the additional height.

d1r5B.idea: Test a compromise that retains complete teacher names and gives notes more space, while allowing the longest room label to wrap if necessary.

s0A.idea: Give the room column enough width for both named rooms to remain on one line, improving room lookup. The notes retain the remaining width; render to check whether their additional wrapping is an acceptable trade-off.

contrast.idea: The time column has only 79 px of text space, less than the 89 px needed for a complete time range. The narrow notes column also creates unnecessary wrapping, while the day column receives more width than its content needs.

contrast.why: All content is visible, but every time range breaks across two lines and the narrow notes column produces long rows. The day and several short-data columns have space that would be more useful elsewhere.

d3r4B.why: Times and teacher names stay together, and most notes read in two lines. The gym name wraps and two notes take three lines, but the schedule remains easy to scan.

ref_auto.why: The wide notes column reads comfortably, but every time range wraps and several teacher names split across lines. Those breaks make frequent timetable lookups harder despite the compact height.

ref_equal.why: Text remains visible and times stay together, but the very narrow notes column breaks sentences into many short lines. Tall rows and large empty areas make the schedule difficult to scan.

d2r1A.why: Times and teacher names stay on one line, with enough room for most notes to read in two lines. The gym name wraps, and two longer notes create taller rows.

d1r2A.why: Times and teachers are easy to scan, and the wider notes column reduces one row to two lines. The narrow room column splits both the lab identifier and gym name, making those destinations less immediate.

acceptance.unsure: B and E are extremely close: their room and notes widths differ by only two pixels, so the preference for E is slight. F is more compact, but splitting the lab identifier is a meaningful tradeoff for a timetable.

ref_equal.why: The narrow notes column forces long passages into up to eight short lines, making the timetable very tall and leaving large empty areas in the other columns. Times and names remain intact, but reading notes and scanning across rows are cumbersome.

d3r4B.why: Times, subjects and teacher names stay on one line, while notes read in manageable lines. The sports hall wraps, and the physics note makes its row taller, but the timetable remains easy to scan.

ref_auto.why: The generous notes column creates a compact table, but every time range splits across lines and several teacher names wrap. Those breaks interrupt two key timetable lookup fields.

contrast.why: Names and rooms generally stay together, but every time range splits and the narrower notes column produces taller rows. Space in the day and other short-field columns contributes little to lookup.

d2r1A.why: Full time ranges and teacher names remain on one line, with readable notes and clear day groups. The sports hall wraps and two rows are taller, but the overall balance supports quick lookup.

d1r2A.why: Time ranges and teacher names stay intact, and the wider notes column makes the physics row shorter. The narrower room column splits both the lab identifier and sports hall across lines, making room lookup slightly less immediate.

acceptance.unsure: B and E are very close: their room and notes widths differ by only 2 px. F is more compact but separates two room labels; the relative importance of that tradeoff depends on how often readers look up rooms.

contrast.why: The time ranges break across two lines throughout, while the notes need three or four lines. Wide day and room columns leave space that could make the timetable easier to scan.

d2r1A.why: Times, subjects and teacher names stay on one line, and the notes are easy to follow. The gym name wraps, and two longer notes create taller rows.

d3r4B.why: Like B, it keeps the principal timetable entries on one line and gives the notes a workable measure. The gym name wraps and two notes extend to a third line.

ref_auto.why: The wide notes column reads comfortably, but every time range and several teacher names split across lines. Those breaks make the main schedule harder to scan despite the compact rows.

ref_equal.why: The narrow notes column forces many short lines and very tall rows, separating successive lessons. Most other columns have extensive empty space while the notes are difficult to read continuously.

d1r2A.why: Times and teacher names remain whole, and the wider notes column produces a compact, regular schedule. The lab number and gym name wrap in the narrow room column, slightly slowing room lookup.

acceptance.unsure: F's advantage over B and C is modest: its shorter notes and more even row heights come at the cost of splitting the lab label from its number. A reader who prioritizes room lookup may prefer B or C.

L04.why: The narrow day column splits ראשון and שלישי inside the words, damaging the main row-group labels. Times and teacher names stay together, and the table fits.

L03.why: Days, subjects and time ranges stay whole, and the notes have a workable measure. Several teacher names wrap across two lines, making that column less easy to scan.

d2r1A.why: Day labels, time ranges, subjects and teacher names remain whole, while notes wrap naturally. The sports hall wraps to two lines, but the table remains easy to scan and balanced.

L07.why: Most time ranges break across two lines while one remains on one line. This disrupts comparison in a timetable, although words, day labels and teacher names remain whole.

L02.why: Time ranges, day labels and subjects stay whole, and the notes read comfortably. One teacher name wraps, while the extra room width still leaves the sports hall on two lines.

L01.why: The final letter of שלישי sits alone on a second line in the day header. The rest of the table scans well, but this break harms a prominent group label.

L05.why: The mathematics label breaks inside the word, two time ranges wrap, and a room identifier splits across lines. These breaks interrupt several key lookup fields.

L06.why: The day column breaks both ראשון and שלישי inside the words, leaving a single letter on its own in the first label. Other key fields stay together.

landscape.unsure: A and H have similarly damaging breaks in the same day labels; their small visual difference does not support a meaningful quality distinction. The grades assume the visible wrapped characters are all present, as the renders suggest.

L04.why: The first and third day names break inside words in the narrow row-header column, making day lookup harder. Times and teacher names remain on one line.

d2r1A.why: Day names, time ranges and teacher names stay whole, making the timetable easy to scan. The sports hall wraps naturally over two lines, and the notes have a comfortable width.

L03.why: Days and times are clear, but several teacher names wrap across two lines. The extra width given to subjects does not visibly provide a comparable benefit.

L01.why: The final letter of the third day name sits alone on a second line in a prominent merged row header. Times and teacher names otherwise scan well.

L02.why: Days and time ranges stay whole, while one teacher name wraps naturally between its two words. The room and notes columns remain readable.

L07.why: Day and teacher names remain whole, but most time ranges split across lines while one stays on one line. That inconsistency makes times harder to compare.

d2r1A.why: Times, subjects and teacher names stay on one line, making the timetable easy to scan. The sports hall wraps and the long notes create some dense rows.

L09.why: The subject column splits the final letter from mathematics and history, disrupting two prominent lookup entries. Times and teacher names remain intact.

L12.why: Times and subjects are easy to scan, but several teacher names wrap between given name and surname. The wider room column still leaves the sports hall on two lines.
